description: Savor the vibrant flavors of Mexico with this refreshing Ceviche de Camaron Shrimp Lime. Fresh shrimp is marinated in bright citrus, then mixed with crisp vegetables for a perfect balance of taste and texture. This authentic dish is a true celebration of Mexican coastal cuisine, ideal for a warm day.

ingredients.notes: peeled, deveined, tails off, finely chopped
finely minced, seeds removed for less heat

instructions.title: Prepare the Shrimp
instructions.text: Start by cleaning your shrimp. Peel, devein, and remove the tails. Chop the shrimp into small, bite-sized pieces. Place the chopped shrimp in a non-reactive bowl.

instructions.title: Marinate in Lime Juice
instructions.text: Pour the fresh lime juice over the chopped shrimp, ensuring all pieces are submerged. Stir gently. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or until the shrimp turns opaque and pink, indicating it has "cooked" in the acid.

instructions.title: Chop the Vegetables
instructions.text: While the shrimp is marinating, finely dice the red onion, Roma tomatoes, and cucumber. Mince the jalapeño or serrano pepper, removing seeds if you prefer less heat. Chop the fresh cilantro.

instructions.title: Combine Ingredients
instructions.text: Once the shrimp is cooked, drain about half of the lime juice from the bowl, leaving enough to keep the ceviche moist. Add the diced red onion, tomatoes, cucumber, minced pepper, and chopped cilantro to the shrimp. Stir gently to combine all ingredients.

instructions.title: Season and Chill
instructions.text: Season the ceviche with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Mix well. For best flavor, cover the bowl and refrigerate for another 15-20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.

instructions.title: Serve Fresh
instructions.text: Just before serving, dice the ripe avocado and gently fold it into the ceviche, or use it as a garnish on top. Serve the Ceviche de Camaron immediately with crispy tostadas or your favorite tortilla chips. Enjoy this refreshing Mexican delight!

tips: Always use fresh, high-quality shrimp for the best texture and flavor. The lime juice "cooks" the shrimp, so freshness is key.
For an extra layer of flavor, you can add a splash of Clamato juice or orange juice to your ceviche mixture. Adjust the amount of jalapeño or serrano to your preferred spice level.
Ceviche is best enjoyed fresh on the day it's made. If you have leftovers, store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator for no more than one day.
